Marketrng, a strategic tool for business development, is critical for the growth and
survival of MSMEs. Due to the lack of information, scarcity of resources and
unorganized ways of selling /marketing, MSME sector often faces problems in
explonng new markets and retaining the existing ones. Keeping in view these facts,
the Procurement and Marketing Support Scheme has been introduced to enhalce
the marketability of products and services in the MSME sector.

Fromoting new market access initiatives like organizing / participation in

across ttre country.

policy and procedure, GeM portal, MSME Conclave, latest developments in

access developments.
